mapper.insert: insert into raffle_activity_order (user_id, sku, activity_id, activity_name, strategy_id, order_id, order_time, state, out_business_no, total_count, day_count, month_count, create_time, update_time, pay_amount) values (#{userId}, #{sku}, #{activityId}, #{activityName}, #{strategyId}, #{orderId}, #{orderTime}, #{state}, #{outBusinessNo}, #{totalCount}, #{dayCount}, #{monthCount}, now(), now(), #{payAmount})
mapper.select: select user_id, sku, activity_id, activity_name, strategy_id, order_id, order_time, state, pay_amount from raffle_activity_order where user_id = #{userId}

select user_id, sku, activity_id, activity_name, strategy_id, order_id, order_time, total_count, day_count, month_count, pay_amount, state from raffle_activity_order where user_id = #{userId} and out_business_no = #{outBusinessNo}

SELECT user_id, sku, activity_id, activity_name, strategy_id, order_id, order_time, total_count, day_count, month_count, pay_amount, state FROM raffle_activity_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sku = #{sku} AND state = 'wait_pay' AND order_time >= now() - INTERVAL 1 MONTH LIMIT 1
